slides.headline: You're losing safety by ignoring AI (artificial intelligence) risks
Microsoft warns Anthropic could harm people
slides.body: On Sep 10, Microsoft said rival artificial intelligence (AI) firm Anthropic might cause disastrous effects if unchecked.

slides.headline: Anthropic builds safe artificial intelligence
slides.body: Their Claude chatbot, an artificial intelligence (AI) tool, avoids harmful answers but Microsoft worries it could still fail.

slides.headline: Jobs and news could suffer
slides.body: If powerful artificial intelligence (AI) acts unsafe, it might replace workers faster or spread believable lies online.

slides.headline: Heed warning, watch hype
slides.body: Microsoft may overstate risk to slow Anthropic, yet artificial intelligence (AI) safety truly matters for everyone.

slides.headline: Follow for safety news
slides.body: Get plain‑English updates on how artificial intelligence (AI) affects jobs, privacy, and daily life.
